answer.rationale: Rollback is ruled out by compliance (security patch), failover mid-peak risks in-flight write loss, capacity provisioning is slow, and no partner dependency failure is indicated for a circuit breaker. Memory b5 reports that shifting report/read queries to replicas relieved primary load and recovered transactional write latency the same day — the closest match to a write-path latency climb under heavy mixed load. I want b5's source verified before committing, since it is the sole basis for choosing this over add_capacity. If verification shows the earlier case was read-dominated rather than write-path, I would reassess toward add_capacity.
